llm_response.reason: Extensive negative reviews and investigations label QuiBids as exploiting users via a penny auction model where customers lose money chasing the illusion of cheap deals. Practices include psychological manipulation, disguised costs, and a business structure that has attracted lawsuits and scam warnings. Characteristics present include ambiguous information, upfront fees, loss due to psychological tactics, and an unsustainable promise of low purchase prices. While not a classic phishing scam, it is widely considered an unethical, deceptive online shopping scam.
